items.q: This concert was organized entirely by Mr. Edmund T. Jenkins who was the president of this society.

ctx.x: So, with the aid of Mr. Latimore, and Dad Cook--Will Marion Cook -- and the dignitaries, they formed "A Coterie of Friends," which represented a cultural society of brotherhood.
This concert was organized entirely by Mr. Edmund T. Jenkins who was the president of this society.
He was the son of Daniel Jenkins?
